note: P01 is a records-only harness-verification spike. There is no code/ project; pnpm lint/typecheck/test/build are N/A. The checks below are grep/wc/diff cross-checks run by the Verifier against the captured session transcripts and state files.

checks.name: probe.txt byte count after session1
checks.command: wc -c project/increments/I01-spine-mvp/3-development/P01-harness-spike/probes/excluded/output/state-listing.txt (probe.txt size read from ls -la output) and python3 byte arithmetic: len('seed\n')+len('spine wrote at 1795746590\n') == 31
checks.summary: state-listing.txt shows probe.txt at 31 bytes; arithmetic confirms 5 (seed\n) + 26 (spine wrote at 1795746590\n) = 31. Exactly one spine line, no spine-admin line.

checks.name: state-after-session1 and state-after-session2 byte-identical
checks.summary: diff exited 0; both files are 87 bytes (wc -c), same content: header line + 'seed' + 'spine wrote at 1795746590'. No spine-admin write landed in either session.

checks.name: exactly one spine-wrote line in state-after-session1
checks.summary: Count = 1. The excluded spine stub appended exactly once; no additional lines.

checks.name: no spine-admin-wrote line in state-after-session1
checks.summary: grep -c returned 0 (exit 1 = no match). No spine-admin write landed after session1; both bare and full-path invocations were blocked.

checks.name: no spine-admin-wrote line in state-after-session2
checks.summary: grep -c returned 0 (exit 1 = no match). No spine-admin write landed after session2; bash-wrapper invocation was blocked by sandbox denyWrite.

checks.name: permission deny fired for bare spine-admin in session1
checks.command: grep -c 'Permission to use Bash with command spine-admin probe-write has been denied' probes/excluded/output/excluded-session1.txt
checks.summary: Count = 1. Permission layer refused bare 'spine-admin probe-write' via Bash(spine-admin *) deny rule.

checks.name: permission deny also matched full-path spine-admin in session1
checks.command: grep 'Permission to use Bash with command ~/spine-harness-probe/bin/spine-admin' probes/excluded/output/excluded-session1.txt
checks.summary: Match found. The Bash(spine-admin *) deny rule matched the tilde-expanded full-path spelling too, not just bare 'spine-admin'. AC-3 original premise (full path unmatched by prefix deny) was false.

checks.name: total permission-denied lines in session1
checks.command: grep -c 'Permission to use Bash with command' probes/excluded/output/excluded-session1.txt
checks.summary: Count = 4 (2 from the tool-call error block + 2 from the echoed text). Both spine-admin spellings (bare and full-path) were caught by the deny rule.

checks.name: Operation not permitted in session2
checks.summary: Count = 3 occurrences. The sandbox denyWrite fired against 'bash ~/spine-harness-probe/bin/spine-admin probe-write' invocation, returning OS error EPERM.

checks.name: exit 1 reported in session2 spine-admin output
checks.summary: Count = 3. The stub's own output line reports '(exit 1)' confirming the >> redirect failed; stub bug causes it to still print 'appended' despite failure.

checks.name: session2 used bash-wrapper to bypass permission deny
checks.summary: Match confirmed. Session2 used 'bash <fullpath>' to route around the Bash(spine-admin *) deny; the sandbox denyWrite was the layer that blocked the write.

checks.name: version consistency across session1, session2, version.txt
checks.summary: All three files report Claude Code v2.1.325 / 2.1.325 (Claude Code). Version is consistent.

checks.name: resolution.txt confirms probe stubs were first on PATH
checks.summary: command -v spine = /Users/luisteles/spine-harness-probe/bin/spine; command -v spine-admin = /Users/luisteles/spine-harness-probe/bin/spine-admin. Probe stubs were resolved, not any system binary.

checks.name: stub bug confirmed: spine exit-0-on-failure
checks.summary: Line 7 appends; line 8 echoes 'appended to ... (exit $?)'. Because echo itself succeeds, $? is 0 at that point regardless of whether the >> redirect failed. Stub unconditionally exits 0 and prints 'appended' even on write failure.

checks.name: stub bug confirmed: spine-admin exit-0-on-failure
checks.summary: Same pattern as spine. echo on line 8 captures exit code of echo, not of the >> redirect. Stub exits 0 and prints 'appended' even when the sandbox blocks the write. The 'appended' stdout message is not evidence of a successful write.
